input.jd_text:
ML Engineer (Early Career) — Recommendations Team

We're growing our recommendations team and looking for engineers comfortable picking up ML on the job. Strong programmers welcome — we'll teach you ML if you can ship clean code.

What you'll do:
- Build and ship recommendation models (collaborative filtering, two-tower, sequence models)
- Own the offline → online evaluation pipeline
- Work with TBs of clickstream data on Spark / Databricks
- Pair with senior MLEs on architecture and on-call rotations

Required:
- 2+ years of production engineering, any language
- Solid Python (or willingness to ramp fast)
- SQL fluency — joins, window functions, query plans
- Comfort with Linux, Git, Docker
- Can read research papers and translate them into production code

Preferred:
- Prior ML/DL exposure: PyTorch or TensorFlow, even at the tutorial level
- Spark / Databricks / distributed compute experience
- Statistics fundamentals: A/B testing, hypothesis tests

expected_output_shape.skill_assessments: Python likely UNDERSTAND (low confidence, since intro coursework), SQL likely APPLY (PostgreSQL experience transfers), Linux/Git/Docker likely UNDERSTAND-APPLY
